name: Lánycsók (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 2:1:2, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing two peasants in red holding a bunch of grapes below the year 1770.
history: Lánycsók had its arms and flag made in 1992. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: disc with two peasants, grapes and the year 1770
